name: Nickel carbonate hydroxide
description: Nickel carbonate hydroxide (CAS 12607-70-4 ), also referred to as trinickel carbonate tetrahydroxide, is an inorganic nickel salt used primarily as a catalyst precursor and as a source compound in nickel-based chemical processing. Its controlled decomposition behavior and high nickel content make it a preferred starting material where precise metal loading and purity are critical procurement considerations for industrial manufacturers. In catalyst manufacturing, it serves as a precursor for producing nickel oxide and reduced nickel catalysts used in hydrogenation, reforming, and methanation processes across various chemical sectors. Battery and electrochemical manufacturers use it as an intermediate in synthesizing nickel-based active materials for rechargeable cell chemistries, ensuring high performance and stability in energy storage. In the pigments and colorants sector, it functions as a raw material for producing green nickel-based inorganic pigments used in ceramics and specialty coatings for high-durability industrial applications. Metallurgical operations also source it for nickel salt production and as a feedstock in refining and plating chemical preparation, where consistent chemical properties are required for quality control. Nickel carbonate hydroxide is supplied as a fine green powder, with particle size and nickel content being key specification parameters for industrial buyers seeking reliable chemical performance. Technical grade is the standard commercial form, with nickel content typically specified on a dry-weight basis.
